newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse slips, volume up on brewery interest.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse slips, volume up on brewery interest.

text.p: Ghana Stock Exchange indices slipped on Friday but the week ended with a flurry as block trading in brewery shares swelled volume, its market report showed.
The GSE All-Share Index fell 0.78 points to 381.37 points from 382.15 on Wednesday.

More than 4.2 million shares were traded on Friday compared to 48,670 in Wednesday's thin trading. Demand for once outstripped offers by 14,006,140 to 5,143,010. On Wednesday, offers exceeded bids by 1,221,380 shares to 342,500.
A total of 2,730,700 Accra Brewery Limited shares changed hands on an all-or-nothing basis. The price rose 19 cedis to 530 cedis with offers at 9.03 million.
A total of 1,513,700 Kumasi Brewery Limited shares changed hands on the same basis. Offers stood at 4.5 million. Shares closed unchanged at 650 cedis.

UTC-Estates (-16 cedis to 44 cedis), Unilever (-7 cedis to 790 cedis), Social Security Bank (-2 cedis to 1,033 cedis), CFAO (-2 cedis to 18 cedis) and Guinness Ghana Limited (-1 cedi to 242 cedis) dragged the index down.
